params.body:
Closes #993

In the chassis lookup dialog a number that is too short is refused by validation. In Dutch the dealer read "Deze waarde bevat te weinig characters"; in French the line under the field read `createCarDNA fr`, in English `createCarDNA eng`: the placeholders in `resources/lang/{fr,en}/carDna.php` were never replaced, and `CarVweRequest::messages()` points the `min` and `max` rules at them.

The French and English `carDna.php` now carry the messages for `min`, `max`, `no_more_credits` and `resting_tokens`. The sibling `carVWE.php` had the same placeholder for `no_more_credits` in both languages, which the header button shows as a tooltip once the credits are gone; translated as well. Dutch and German were already right and are unchanged.

Tests: `ChassisLookupMessagesTest` validates a three-character chassis number in the four languages and reads the message back, and checks that no value in `carDna` or `carVWE` is still a placeholder or repeats its own key. Both fail on main.
params.title: The chassis lookup answers in French and English instead of a placeholder
